full_text:
A traveler asked Nasruddin: "Mulla, why did the Creator divide time into day and night?"

"It was at my personal suggestion!" replied Nasruddin solemnly. "I told Him: if there were only day, the merchants would never stop haggling in the bazaar; and if there were only night, the thieves would steal the town gates! By putting day between nights and nights between days, honest folk have time to sleep and thieves have to wait their turn!"
moral: The universe operates by cosmic laws, regardless of human vanity.
